decisions.briefing: Markets were quietly mixed today (NASDAQ +0.7%, S&P 500 +0.3%) with no strong risk-on catalyst. Cash sits at $389, just under our $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we held all 7 positions and skipped new buys rather than forcing capital into a neutral session.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices closed modestly higher, with the S&P 500 up 0.3% and the Nasdaq up 0.7%, in a session lacking any major catalyst or scheduled economic data. Without a dominant news driver, trading stayed range-bound as investors digested recent gains rather than reacting to fresh headlines. This kind of quiet, low-volatility day typically reflects consolidation after a run-up rather than a shift in sentiment.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數溫和收高，標普500指數上漲0.3%，納斯達克指數上漲0.7%，市場缺乏重大消息面或經濟數據刺激。在沒有明顯新聞主導的情況下，交易呈現區間震盪，投資人傾向消化近期漲幅，而非對突發消息作出反應。這種低波動的平靜交易日，通常反映的是漲勢後的整理階段，而非市場情緒的轉變。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. Today our cash balance was below our usual buy threshold and the market gave no clear risk-on signal, so holding that cash rather than forcing a trade is a deliberate, disciplined choice.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指保留在場邊、等待真正好機會出現時才動用的現金。今日我們的現金餘額低於一般加碼門檻，市場也沒有明確的風險偏好訊號，因此保留現金而非勉強交易，是一種有紀律的策略選擇。
